productionSchemaReplay.scope: Actual recorded production SQL, authorizer, type inference and 128-entry/4-MiB cache. Complete schema comparison. Includes fresh per-program declaration contexts and metadata output retention. No rule execution, rows or engine scheduler. Tests unchanged decisions; does not prove source-version result reuse.

overlayManifest.scope: Actual terminal diagnostic SQL producers under the existing query-size limit. Authored options and defaults preserved. Same input domain, predicates, row multiplicity, deferred and native producer cuts. No shipped policy or engine alternative changes.

decisions.anchors: Use persisted SQL cardinalities, one emitted arm, and an outer demand gate.
decisions.fusion: Fuse physical families after validation. Materialize only justified same-scope shared cuts. Policy-only fusion has no proven CPU win.
decisions.native: Keep whole-demand typed-column contract. Do not promote the native child operator as a CPU optimization; the scalar control remains faster.
decisions.publication: Batch 32 files with current FTS layout, triggers and 1-MiB cache. Grouped statistics and larger caches have no clear reason for promotion.
decisions.planning: Use one family batch and stable prepared templates. Preserve the existing bounded schema cache; its no-sharing control is not the current engine.
decisions.memory: Remove schema fan-out; measure source/AST, projections, SQL and graph ownership before setting cache policies.
decisions.acceptance: No production speedup claimed. Measure complete uninstrumented 50/60 workloads after an implementation delivery.

finalLab.sourceDifference: The packet-triggers publication control uses cacheKiB=8192 instead of 1024. The selected anchor, fusion, native, planning, metadata and composed experiments do not execute publication.
